services.name: Backcountry Inshore and Nearshore Tarpon Fishing • The Silver King!
services.desc: We are in full blown tarpon season now!! Book now for the fight of a life with the most powerful saltwater light tackle gamefish on earth! Unleash the thrill of the hunt with our Backcountry Inshore and Nearshore Tarpon Fishing - where every line cast holds the promise of an adrenaline-pumping battle with the silver king of the sea. We offer inshore backcountry and nearshore beach tarpon charters. Our season is usually from April thru November but that can change due to weather. Peak tarpon can be June July August and September 4-5 hours • Tarpon charters normally start just before Typically April thru December is Tarpon Season • 4 & 5 hours • Up to 4 people • Apex Fish!

services.name: Dolphin Manatee Wildlife Tour Cruise
services.desc: Dive into wonder and witness the magic of the east Central Florida Atlantic waters with our Dolphin Manatee Wildlife Tour - where every wave carries the chance to encounter nature's most enchanting creatures in their breathtaking habitat. These tours are also within the Merritt Island National Wildlife Refuge and the Canaveral National Seashore, which is a prime nesting area for several species of sea turtles. 2 Plus Hours • Start times for this can vary and we can be flexible on this. Most of the time we start around sunrise, give or take. Please tell us your needs and we can go Great fun for the whole family! • 2 hours • Up to 6 people can go • Offered year round
